component_panel.description: Agent component panel — the single surface for present_chat_component renderings. FULL VIEW is its only open state (CHAT-COMPONENT-FULL-VIEW): a full-height overlay pinned below the chat header tabs and ABOVE the composer (the composer stays visible and usable), as wide as the transcript's content width (chat_common.content_max_width). There is no drawer and no expand control; the header tabs open it and the (—) header button closes it. Components load silently behind the chat pill by default; users open them from their header tabs. Set auto_open_on_present true only for a surface that deliberately needs live presentation. Radius defaults to 12px (structural CSS in app1.css); override with "radius" (any CSS length).

user_turn_anchor._instructions: Edit up/down snap_distance_px (capture margin) and snap_rearm_distance_px (outer zone) independently. The shared landing zone uses the up outer distance below the landing and the down outer distance above it. Snap and layout movement do not rearm it. Pixel distances and millisecond durations. Refresh after editing. enabled: Enable user-turn landing and nearby snaps; false disables both. landing_gap_px: Minimum user-bubble landing offset below the transcript top, in pixels; header clearance can increase it. snap_enabled: Enable soft snapping; disabling it leaves open/send landing enabled unless enabled is also false. snap_distance_px: Capture margin from the user-bubble landing position, in pixels. Directional values override the flat fallback. snap_settle_ms: Delay after reader scrolling stops before looking for a nearby eligible anchor, in milliseconds. header_clearance_px: Extra clearance below the measured header when calculating the landing position, in pixels. snap_rearm_distance_px: Outer rearm distance in pixels. A landing blocks all nearby snaps until reader scrolling leaves this distance; the applicable side also rearms its individual cooldown. snap_tolerance_px: Distance in pixels considered already landed; consumes the snap without issuing another scroll. snap_complete_fallback_ms: Maximum wait in milliseconds for snap completion when scrollend does not arrive. scroll_intent_ms: How long after a reader gesture scroll events are treated as reader intent, in milliseconds. focus_hold_ms: How long inactive-run automatic user-turn focus is retained after arming, in milliseconds; active runs refresh this deadline. tail_follow_distance_px: Distance from the transcript tail in pixels at which reader scrolling enables tail following.
user_turn_anchor.description: Independent up/down anchor tuning with a shared landing zone. After any landing, all bubble snaps pause until reader scrolling leaves the configured rearm distance from that landing position. This prevents nearby bubbles from alternating snaps. Individual directional cooldowns still apply. Device profiles override Common.

down._instructions: snap_enabled: Allow snaps approaching the landing from above (scrolling downward). The shared landing-zone lock still applies. snap_distance_px: Capture margin from the user-bubble landing position, in pixels. Directional values override the flat fallback. snap_rearm_distance_px: Outer rearm distance in pixels. A landing blocks all nearby snaps until reader scrolling leaves this distance; the applicable side also rearms its individual cooldown.

up._instructions: snap_enabled: Allow snaps approaching the landing from below (scrolling upward). The shared landing-zone lock still applies. snap_distance_px: Capture margin from the user-bubble landing position, in pixels. Directional values override the flat fallback. snap_rearm_distance_px: Outer rearm distance in pixels. A landing blocks all nearby snaps until reader scrolling leaves this distance; the applicable side also rearms its individual cooldown.

user_turn_anchor._instructions: Edit up/down snap_distance_px (capture margin) and snap_rearm_distance_px (outer zone) independently. The shared landing zone uses the up outer distance below the landing and the down outer distance above it. Snap and layout movement do not rearm it. Pixel distances and millisecond durations. Refresh after editing. landing_gap_px: Minimum user-bubble landing offset below the transcript top, in pixels; header clearance can increase it. snap_distance_px: Capture margin from the user-bubble landing position, in pixels. Directional values override the flat fallback. snap_rearm_distance_px: Outer rearm distance in pixels. A landing blocks all nearby snaps until reader scrolling leaves this distance; the applicable side also rearms its individual cooldown.
user_turn_anchor.description: Independent up/down anchor tuning with a shared landing zone. After any landing, all bubble snaps pause until reader scrolling leaves the configured rearm distance from that landing position. This prevents nearby bubbles from alternating snaps. Individual directional cooldowns still apply. Device profiles override Common.

down._instructions: snap_enabled: Allow snaps approaching the landing from above (scrolling downward). The shared landing-zone lock still applies. snap_distance_px: Capture margin from the user-bubble landing position, in pixels.
